scope: Theorem 4.5 of the manuscript “Modularity of elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields” (preprints/Modularity-of-elliptic-curves-over-imaginary-quadratic-fields-October-4-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 030 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c74cc37755f500be), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In one integral basis ai, bi as above, the geometric monodromy of the constant-E family contains operators Ta, Tb satisfying Ta(aj) = aj, Ta(bj) = bj + σa(2aj − aj−1 − aj+1), (4.5) Tb(bj) = bj, Tb(aj) = aj + σb(2bj − bj−1 − bj+1), (4.6) where σa, σb ∈ {1, −1} are independent of j. Equivalently, their two off-diagonal entries, in the basis of the free Z[Γm]-module, are σa(2 − u − u−1) and σb(2 − u − u−1). The geometric monodromy of the family over U contains these actions as well, under the pullback identification.
